Dialogs.Dialog: Um... ▲小早川＊▲, what do you think about... kissing and stuff？
Well, sometimes I think maybe I'm being a little pushy...
I wouldn't want it to be forced, so...
A little pushy is fine. Honestly, sometimes I don't mind...
When I don't want it, I'll tell you. With a headbang.
Um... ▲小早川＊▲, what do you think about... kissing and stuff？
Like, you know... you kind of like it, or actually not so much...？
...Whatever. If you want to, just do it.
From my side, I'm always nervous you might not like it...
Well, that's... I have my own circumstances too...
But if you're really thinking about Rinko, then, like, anytime...
Um... ▲小早川＊▲, what do you think about... kissing and stuff？
Well... sometimes I wonder if I'm pushing you.
You're not pushing me... but when it's sudden, it surprises me a little.
Rinko's the one who should be sorry, okay？ I'll try not to be so surprised.
Um... ▲小早川＊▲, what do you think about... kissing and stuff？
Wha!? What are you saying？ Idiot...
W-Well, yeah. But I was just wondering.
I see, normal... So ▲小早川＊▲ kisses... normally...
No！ That's not it！ What about you, then？
Me？ W-Well, I'm older, so... a fair amount... normally？
So you've done it before. Huh...
I didn't think you'd do such dirty stuff. ...Stay away from me.
Um, why do you... kiss Rinko？
Huh？ Well, I like kissing too, but it's ▲小早川＊▲ I love.
I see... Then, one more question.
Just if, okay... if Rinko kissed you... would you hate that？
No way I'd hate it... Wait, don't tell me, now...？
(But the way that conversation was going...)
Hey, when do you, um... kiss Rinko？
!? Um, well... when I suddenly think you're cute？
Never mind. Then, if... just hypothetically, 99.99% it would never happen.
If Rinko kissed you... would you think she's a dirty girl？
Huh... Of course not！ Want to tr—
Um, so... when do you feel like kissing Rinko？
!? Um, well... there are lots of times...
Rinko can usually tell, you know. When it's about to happen.
▲主人公＊▲. Then can you tell when Rinko wants to kiss？
You can't, huh... Then maybe from now on I'll make it easier to tell.
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
That's... You don't ask embarrassing stuff like that. Normally...
Yeah... but I thought maybe we should talk about it once in a while.
I don't really know. This is my first time with this kind of thing. But...
Are you happy Rinko's here？ Does your heart pound？
Rinko too. Just being together makes my heart pound and makes me happy. So much it's scary.
I don't really get it, but that's how it is for Rinko.
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
Wh... What are you saying？ Idiot.
W-Well, yeah. But it's important, right？ For both of us.
Is it？ Things'll turn out however they turn out.
Even if we didn't work out, that's just how it goes？
Huh... No. I didn't say that.
It can't be helped. Rinko feels like she's not herself either...
It can't be helped！ I'm a pain to deal with！
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
W-Well, it's a little embarrassing. But it's important, right？
I guess... But I don't really know. It's my first time being someone's girlfriend.
Rinko too. I'll probably want to ask again, is that okay？
If someone confessed to you, ▲小早川＊▲, what would be ideal？
!? What's gotten into you？ Been playing otome games？
Well, guys think about that kind of stuff too.
So, what would it be like？
Me... I'm fine with something normal.
Well, assuming he's super handsome, smart, and mature, of course...
Oh, no. I was just wondering if it'd be like that.
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
You asked me that before, so I've been thinking about it.
But I still don't really know. Only...
▲主人公＊▲. Rinko's in love right now.
It's not like anything in any book, and not like any feeling I've known before...
Nobody taught me, but I know for sure... that I'm in love. It's strange...
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
You asked me that before. So I've been thinking about it.
When I'm with you, I get embarrassed and happy, and my chest gets so jumbled it feels like it'll overflow.
▲主人公＊▲, you always look so calm, and it's only Rinko acting like an idiot...
I'm not calm either, you know.
I hate myself for it. I hate it... but being apart is even worse.
When I can't see you, I'm lonely...
Sorry Rinko's such a pain. Thanks, always.
▲小早川＊▲, how do you feel about love？
You asked me that before, right？ I've been thinking, and I figured something out.
Yeah. That Rinko really is in love.
▲主人公＊▲, sometimes you tell Rinko you love her, right？
I'm happy about it because I want to make sure we both feel the same way.
Rinko's never confident, so she gets anxious fast, and it hurts.
But every time you say you love me, the middle of my chest gets warm. I can like myself.
That's because Rinko really is in love.
When do you get jealous, ▲小早川＊▲？
Well... over me, maybe？ We are going out, after all？
Like, if I were super popular with girls.
Well... not really, at the moment.
Ask me again when you're super popular, then？
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲小早川＊▲？
Wha... When has Rinko ever been jealous over you？
Never means never！ Are you stupid？
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲小早川＊▲？
Jealous？ I'm not... It's fine. Rinko trusts you.
Yeah. That you're only looking at Rinko.
Even if you sneak glances at other girls on our dates.
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲小早川＊▲？
I see. But a lot of girls get pretty jealous, right？
Well, yeah. There are girls like that in my class.
Totally serious, like, "No, no！ Look only at me！"...
N-O!! Geez... Are you stupid？ Idiooot！
When do you get jealous, ▲小早川＊▲？
I think Rinko's actually super jealous. I didn't know that about myself either.
It's probably because I'm not confident. So I want you to give me more confidence...
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲小早川＊▲？
Again... For the record, Rinko does NOT get jealous！ Ever！
So even if I liked another girl？
Even hypothetically, saying that is way too mean...
As punishment, for the next month, you're banned from talking to any girl but Rinko.
Do you think you're the jealous type, ▲小早川＊▲？
You asked that before too, you know？
Honestly, sometimes I'm not okay. Rinko's not confident in herself.
So when Rinko's anxious, notice it, and tell Rinko...
(So that's it... But yeah, I've got to step up.)
So, how do you feel about... physical affection？
Be smoother about it. Rinko's a girl too, you know.
Got it. I'll work on my technique.
That sounds kind of pervy too.
So, how do you feel about... physical affection？
You look like you're thinking pervy stuff, so no.
Whaa!? I'm not thinking anything like that！
Okay. Then from now on, I'll do it with a totally empty mind...
Like I'd let you touch me with an empty mind, idiot！
So, how do you feel about... physical affection？
Well, you know... I was wondering if you hate it.
Of course I don't hate it. I'm happy？ But...
You might be a little bad at it.
How do you feel about physical affection？ Between guys and girls, I mean.
No！ It doesn't have to mean pervy stuff, right？ For people who are going out？
Do whatever you want, I guess. If that's what they want.
I see. So... what about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Whoever becomes Rinko's boyfriend shall never be free of fresh wounds... Like that.
So, how do you feel about... physical affection？
R-Really... Then you must hate it.
I never said I hate it. Rinko's happy about the feeling behind it. It's just...
How do you feel about physical affection？ Between guys and girls, I mean.
You look like you're thinking pervy stuff.
But it's a little better than before. Just a tiny bit. So... I'll let you.
When I don't like it, I'll tell you. ...With a little kick.
So, how do you feel about... physical affection？
Um, so... I was wondering if you hate it.
Nope. Lately you've been going at Rinko's pace, so I'm happy.
Really!? Then I'll keep working on my technique！
Your eyes are kind of glinting, you know？
